#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile a real Unity launch storyboard with the original ibtool."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,re,runpy,shlex,subprocess,tempfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent;p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--configuration',required=True);p.add_argument('--stage',required=True);p.add_argument('--trace-launch-jobs',action='store_true');p.add_argument('--diagnostic-disable-volume-manager',action='store_true');p.add_argument('--timeout',type=int,default=240);a=p.parse_args();assert 1 <= a.timeout <= 600;folder=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='original-storyboard-',dir=root/'runtime'));sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();guest=lambda p:'/Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/'+str(p.relative_to(root));source=root/'runtime/unity-ios-cocoapods-ios26-v1/ios/LaunchScreen-iPad.storyboard';output=folder/'compiled';output.mkdir()
tool='/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/usr/bin/ibtool';argv=[tool,'--errors','--warnings','--notices','--module','uEmuera','--output-partial-info-plist',guest(folder/'SBPartialInfo.plist'),'--auto-activate-custom-fonts','--target-device','iphone','--target-device','ipad','--minimum-deployment-target','13.0','--output-format','human-readable-text',guest(source),'--compilation-directory',guest(output)]
control=None;prelude=''
if a.diagnostic_disable_volume_manager:
 control_source=root/'fixtures/hello/coresim-service-volume-control.c';control_object=folder/'control.o';control_exe=folder/'control';sdk=root/'runtime/state/prefix/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk'
 commands=[['clang-19','-target','x86_64-apple-macos11','-isysroot',str(sdk),'-Wno-deprecated-declarations','-c',str(control_source),'-o',str(control_object)],['ld64.lld-19','-arch','x86_64','-platform_version','macos','11','11','-syslibroot',str(sdk),'-lSystem',str(control_object),'-o',str(control_exe)]]
 for command in commands:subprocess.run(command,check=True)
 service='/Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/runtime/xcode-system-resources/Library/Developer/PrivateFrameworks/CoreSimulator.framework/Versions/A/XPCServices/com.apple.CoreSimulator.CoreSimulatorService.xpc/Contents/MacOS/com.apple.CoreSimulator.CoreSimulatorService'
 prelude=shlex.join([guest(control_exe),service])+' || exit $?\n'
 control=dict(diagnostic_only=True,volume_manager_enabled=False,service_arguments=[service,'-EnableVolumeManager','NO'],build_commands=commands,source=str(control_source.relative_to(root)),source_sha256=sha(control_source))
script=folder/'run.sh';script.write_text('#!/bin/bash\nulimit -c 0\nunset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY XAUTHORITY\n'+('export DARLING_XPC_TRACE_LAUNCH_JOBS=1\n' if a.trace_launch_jobs else '')+prelude+shlex.join(argv)+'\nstatus=$?\nprintf "ORIGINAL_STORYBOARD_STATUS %s\\n" "$status"\nexit "$status"\n')
m=runpy.run_path(str(root/'scripts/direct-resource-tool-runtime-profile.py'));profile=m['profile'](stage=a.stage,configuration=a.configuration);env=m['environment'](profile)
for key in ['DISPLAY','WAYLAND_DISPLAY','XAUTHORITY']:env.pop(key,None)
cmd=profile['command'][:-2]+['/bin/bash',guest(script)];cmd[3]=str(a.timeout);log=folder/'run.log'
with log.open('w') as out:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
t=log.read_text();statuses=re.findall(r'^ORIGINAL_STORYBOARD_STATUS ([0-9]+)$',t,re.M);products={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in output.rglob('*') if p.is_file()};verified=r.returncode==0 and statuses==['0'] and bool(products)
report=dict(service_volume_control=control,trace_launch_jobs=a.trace_launch_jobs,timeout=a.timeout,verified=verified,outer_status=r.returncode,native_statuses=statuses,configuration=a.configuration,stage=a.stage,arguments=argv,products=products,source_runtime=profile['source_runtime'],log=str(log.relative_to(root)),log_sha256=sha(log),files={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),source,script,root/a.configuration,root/a.stage]},independent_storyboard_semantics_verified=False,full_goal_complete=False)
(folder/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(t[-7000:]);print('EVIDENCE',folder/'result.json');raise SystemExit(0 if verified else 1)
